subject: Tri-Latitude Relay: proposed cadence for exec demo handoffs
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alice Cheng <alice@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2029-08-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Tri-Latitude Relay: proposed cadence for exec demo handoffs

Team / Alice —

Following up from last week's sync: Acme's execs want a short executive walkthrough plus Q&A that works for stakeholders across US, EU, and APAC. We can't expect a single slot that sits perfectly in all zones, so I sketched a rotating "relay" cadence that hands the session between two execs over a ~90 minute run to cover core stakeholders.

High level proposal (attached cadence_matrix.xlsx + .ics):
- Window A (US-friendly): 16:00 PT / 19:00 ET — fast 30-min exec + handoff to EU rep
- Window B (EU overlap): 23:00 ET / 04:00 CET — EU exec leads, APAC joins as early morning
- Window C (APAC anchor): 09:00 SGT / 11:00 AEST — APAC exec covers deep-dive for regional questions

Notes and constraints:
- DST transitions: some EU execs move Oct->Nov; propose anchoring to fixed UTC offsets for scheduling and rotating who covers the delicate weeks.
- Can we reserve a single 90-min block in the calendar and split ownership in the agenda? The attached .ics shows a 90-min block with three agenda anchors.

Asks:
1) Karthik — can you confirm engineering availability for a short live demo during Window A/B?
2) Maya — can you confirm which Acme execs are must-have attendees and their rough timezone constraints so we can pin exact slots?
3) Jonas/Marcus — any known travel/OOO in Sep/Oct that would break a rotational cadence?

If everyone agrees, I'll convert the matrix into a recurring calendar series with rotating primary owner and send a single invite for the quarter.

Thanks,
Grace
Grace O'Connor
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
Attachment: cadence_matrix.xlsx (xlsx, 58KB)
Attachment: proposed_slots.ics (ics, 3KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alice Cheng <alice@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2029-08-21T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tri-Latitude Relay: proposed cadence for exec demo handoffs

Grace —

Thanks, this looks pragmatic. Engineering can support a live demo during Window A most weeks, we only need a heads-up for any load tests or long KV-cache warmups (30-45m prep).

One small ask: for Window B (the late ET / early CET slot) we should avoid scheduling heavy GPU warmups at the start of the block. If the EU exec is intended to lead, let's make the first 10 minutes a short recap and quick smoke test, and move deep generation into the APAC anchor to avoid extra latency risk during handoff.

I'll mark tentative availability and note prep steps.
Karthik
Lead ML Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alice Cheng <alice@acme-corp.com>, Sam Reynolds <sam.reynolds@globex.com>
Date: 2029-08-22T02:28:00+05:30
Subject: Re: Tri-Latitude Relay: proposed cadence for exec demo handoffs

Grace / team —

Acme check-in: Alice confirms three execs who are must-attend — CTO (PT), Head of Product (CET), and APAC GM (SGT). She asked for a single recurring invite if possible; they prefer not to jump between separate events each week.

A couple of clarifications from Acme:
- They prefer the "anchor" exec to rotate weekly rather than daily to avoid repeated timezone strain on any one person.
- During weeks that include DST transitions (their EU exec is traveling late Oct), they'd like to have a secondary backup exec pre-assigned.

Maya (on behalf of Acme) attached a short attendee availability doc (see Drive link in the thread). We should explicitly call out which weeks will be EU/US/APAC anchors in the recurring invite.

Maya Srinivasan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alice Cheng <alice@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2029-08-22T10:45:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Tri-Latitude Relay: proposed cadence for exec demo handoffs

Quick flag on rotation logistics —

We should define a clear handoff script in the calendar description so the transitioning exec knows: 1) who does 0-10m context, 2) who takes 10-40m deep demo, 3) who fields regional Qs last 20m. That avoids awkward pauses during timezone switchover.

Also: for weeks where the EU clock changes (last week of Oct), I recommend we anchor to UTC-based notation in the invite and add an "observed local time" line for each exec in the description — avoids the "one-hour later" confusion that trips people up.

I'll draft a template handoff script and drop it to the Drive folder.

Jonas
VP, Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Alice Cheng <alice@acme-corp.com>
Date: 2029-08-22T13:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Tri-Latitude Relay: proposed cadence for exec demo handoffs

Thanks all — good notes. Action items:
- Jonas: add handoff script to Drive and I'll paste into the recurring invite description.
- Karthik: we'll schedule two warmup/test runs (30m) the week before the first anchor rotation and mark them as optional for Acme execs; please confirm times that work for infra.
- Maya: I'll send a recurring invite that lists the anchor for each week for Q4 and include UTC times + observed local times per participant.

I'll draft the invite today and send for review. If nobody objects by EOD tomorrow, I'll schedule the series to start the week of Sep 9.

Grace
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Alice Cheng <alice@acme-corp.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Maya Srinivasan <maya_srinivasan@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-08-23T15:04:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Tri-Latitude Relay: proposed cadence for exec demo handoffs

Grace / team —

Thanks — this approach works for Acme. We appreciate the rotating anchor and the UTC notes for DST weeks. Please include our backup exec (Head of Eng, sam.eng@acme-corp.com) for Oct/Nov.

Confirming: recurring invite start week of Sep 9 is fine. Looking forward to the test run.

Best,
Alice Cheng
Director of Strategic Partnerships, Acme Corp
